headline: Dangote Cement Surge Lifts Aliko Dangote's Fortune to $55.4 Billion
summary: Aliko Dangote's estimated fortune rose to $55.4 billion as shares in Dangote Cement surged, restoring the company's status as Nigeria's most valuable firm.
why: Dangote Cement is a major constituent of the Nigerian Exchange, and its valuation movements heavily influence the broader local equity market capitalization and index performance.
